trip.hotel: AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta
trip.event: Thunderpick World Championship 2026 Finals, BLAST Arena Studios (Malta Fairs & Conventions Centre, Ta' Qali, ATD 4000 Ħ'Attard), match days 2026-10-14/2026-10-18

items.name: Route 186 (Buġibba–Qawra–Mosta–Ta' Qali–Rabat)
items.address: Qawra seafront stops Arznell (950) / Luzzu (951) / Qawra (952) / Boxxla (953) — the hotel is on the Qawra coast road; venue stops Ta' Qali Stadium & Ta' Qali Villagg
items.hours: Every 30 min. Operator-published outbound times from Arznell 06:08–21:37 (Qawra 06:10–21:38; from Buġibba Bay 6 06:05–21:35); return direction (via St Paul's Bay + Buġibba seafront) last published passing Bugibba Bay 1 at 21:26
items.price_range: €2.50 summer single (in force 13–18 Oct); €2.00 winter from 19 Oct; Explore 7-day card covers it
items.description: THE event-day bus: direct from the hotel's Qawra seafront stops (Arznell 950 / Qawra 952) via Mosta Rotunda to Ta' Qali (Stadium stop for the National Stadium / MFCC area where BLAST Arena Studios sits; Villagg stop for the Crafts Village), continuing to Rabat. Roughly 24–30 minutes Qawra → Ta' Qali.
items.notes: Stop-level detail (stop codes, published departure times, return-direction routing via St Paul's Bay/Buġibba seafront) read from the operator's route page on 9 Oct 2026 by the parallel Qawra re-base session and merged here; this session independently confirmed the route exists, the ~30-min frequency and the live detour notice (toward-Buġibba direction only: stops Gholja 2 through Targa not served — irrelevant for hotel→venue). Late-night limit: last return 21:26 at Buġibba Bay 1 — a match ending after ~20:45 at Ta' Qali cannot be finished by bus. Re-check for diversions in the week of travel (a cached 2025 snapshot showed a weekend 186 detour starting 17 Oct — 2025, not confirmed for 2026; OQ-08).

items.name: Route 214 (Buġibba–Qawra–Rabat–Ta' Qali–Balzan–Airport)
items.address: Serves Qawra, Rabat, Ta' Qali (Qali 2 stop), Marsa P&R, Paola, Malta International Airport
items.price_range: €2.50 summer / €2.00 winter single (2-h transfer validity); cheapest direct airport↔hotel bus
items.description: Follows the old X3 corridor: direct airport ↔ Buġibba/Qawra with the venue (Ta' Qali, Qali 2 stop) on the way. Also the direct RETURN option from the venue to Qawra (Ta' Qali → Rabat → Qawra, ~40 min) when route 186's toward-Buġibba direction bypasses the Qawra seafront.
items.notes: Stop sequence from malta.busatlas.uk Nov 2025 timetable PDF; airport↔Buġibba direct service and 60–70 min / €2–2.50 fare corroborated by seaandstone.blog (Aug 2026) and a 2025 TripAdvisor forum note that 214 replaced X3 from 20 Apr 2025. Confirm current timetable in the tallinja app.

items.name: TD1 Airport Direct (Airport–Rabat–St Paul's Bay–Buġibba–Qawra–Mellieħa–Ċirkewwa)
items.address: Airport bus stops (Airport 1/2/3 area); north-coast stops incl. Qawra & Buġibba
items.hours: Hourly (airport departures roughly 04:00–23:00+); ~39–58 min airport→Buġibba/Qawra depending on stop
items.price_range: €3.50 per journey (the only Airport Direct route at €3.50; others €3.00)
items.description: The all-day direct airport bus for the hotel: airport → Rabat → St Paul's Bay → Buġibba → Qawra → Mellieħa → Ċirkewwa (Gozo ferry). Best arrival/departure option when TD5's limited hours don't fit.
items.notes: Corridor and stops per the operator's April 2025 service-change notice (X1–X4 replaced by Airport Direct; TD1 serves Rabat, St Paul's Bay, Buġibba, Qawra, Mellieħa, Ċirkewwa) quoted in a TripAdvisor forum thread, plus airporttocitycenter.com (27 Sep 2026: 'hourly TD1, EUR 3.50' for Buġibba/St Paul's Bay) and rome2rio (39 min to Buġibba). €3.50 TD1 fare per appsavvytraveller (Sep 2026) and publictransportguide (Jun 2026). Confirm the Qawra stop name/position in the tallinja app.

items.name: TD5 Airport Direct (Airport–Rabat–Buġibba)
items.address: Airport – Aviation – Rohan – Rabat – Wileġ – Arzell – Buġibba Terminus
items.hours: Limited: Mon–Fri six trips ~08:30–14:00; weekends five trips ~08:30–13:00 (hourly); ~50 min airport→Buġibba
items.price_range: €3.00 cash/contactless (€1.50 with a personalised tallinja card)
items.description: Fastest airport↔hotel bus when its limited midday window fits your flight (launched 27 Jul 2025). Buġibba Terminus is a 5-minute walk from AX ODYCY; Qawra is the next coastal strip over.
items.notes: Launch details from TVM News (23 Jul 2025, quoting Malta Public Transport): route, stops, €3.00/€1.50 fares, Mon–Fri 08:30–14:00 & weekend 08:30–13:00 pattern. seaandstone.blog (Aug 2026) independently lists airport departures 08:20–13:20 hourly, ~50 min, €3. Limited hours mean TD1 or 214 usually covers other flight times — check the day's timetable before relying on TD5.

items.name: X3 airport express (Buġibba–Qawra–Mosta–Rabat–Ta' Qali–Attard–Airport)
items.area: Malta International Airport ↔ Buġibba/Qawra (via Ta' Qali/Attard)
items.address: Buġibba bay 6 – Qawra seafront – Burmarrad – Mosta – Mtarfa – Rabat – Ta' Qali – Attard – Balzan – Birkirkara – Marsa – Paola – Luqa – Airport
items.hours: Withdrawn 20 Apr 2025 per the parallel 9 Oct verification; do not plan on it
items.price_range: n/a — withdrawn (route 214 took over the corridor at standard fare)
items.description: Former airport express on the Buġibba–airport corridor. WITHDRAWN 20 Apr 2025 when the airport X services (X1–X4) were replaced by Airport Direct (TD) services; route 214 now follows the old X3 corridor. Even when it ran, it served the venue area only at the Qali 2 stop on the main road — the MFCC is reached from the Ta' Qali Stadium/Villagg stops.
items.notes: CONFLICT (documented, not resolved): a parallel 9 Oct session recorded X3 as withdrawn 20 Apr 2025 (replaced by 214) and corrected an earlier data entry that carried it as verified; this session's read of the operator's route index (9 Oct 2026) still lists X1–X4, and 2026 guides (rozie.app Jun 2026, freemalta 2026, malta-spirit Jul 2026) describe X1–X4 as operating airport expresses. Merged position: treat all X routes as UNCONFIRMED — use TD1/TD5/214 and confirm in the tallinja app. Recorded in docs/FINAL_REPORT.md (parallel session) and docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md.

items.name: X1 airport express (Airport–…–Qawra–San Paul's Bay–Mellieħa–Ċirkewwa)
items.area: Malta International Airport ↔ north coast (Qawra, Mellieħa, Gozo ferry)
items.address: Airport – Luqa – Marsa – Msida – Mater Dei – Swieqi – Pembroke – Baħar iċ-Ċagħaq – Qawra – San Pawl il-Baħar – Xemxija – Mellieħa – Marfa – Ċirkewwa
items.hours: Unconfirmed — the airport X services were replaced by Airport Direct (TD) on 20 Apr 2025; do not plan on X1
items.price_range: Standard day-route fare (€2.50 summer / €2.00 winter) if it runs; 70–80 min airport→Ċirkewwa per old guides
items.description: Former northern airport express serving Qawra directly and linking toward Mellieħa and the Ċirkewwa Gozo ferry terminal.
items.notes: Same X-route conflict as transport-x3: stop list from mappytravel (Dec 2021, pre-dating the 2025 TD changes) and malta-spirit (Jul 2026) describe X1 operating; the operator's route index (9 Oct 2026) lists it; the parallel 9 Oct verification records the airport X services as replaced by TD on 20 Apr 2025. Treat as unconfirmed — use TD1 (which serves the same north-coast corridor) and confirm in the app.

items.name: Explore Adult 7-Day card
items.address: Buy: airport sales offices (Welcomer's Hall & Baggage Reclaim), Valletta Terminal, Buġibba Terminal (5-min walk from the hotel), Sliema Ferries, Agenda/8TillLate/WH Smith shops, card machines, or the tallinja app
items.hours: Valid 7 days (168 h) from first use
items.description: Unlimited travel on all Day Routes and Night Routes incl. route 186/214 to the venue. The value play for your week: every bus journey incl. event days is covered.
items.notes: Operator fares page re-read 9 Oct 2026: €25, unlimited Day + Night Routes, valid Malta & Gozo, sales points incl. Buġibba Terminal. FLAG (unresolved): the same page's summary says the card 'also includes the Airport Direct service' while the card detail says it 'excludes tallinja Direct Routes' — self-contradictory on the operator's own page; budget €3–3.50 per Airport Direct hop separately until confirmed at a sales office.

items.name: 12 Single Day Journeys card
items.address: Same sales points as the Explore card
items.hours: 6 months from first use; 2-hour transfer window per journey
items.price_range: €19 (Night Routes and Airport Direct cost 2 journeys per trip)
items.description: Shareable pay-per-trip card — the alternative if you prefer not to commit to unlimited travel (e.g. if you plan to rideshare most event days).
items.notes: Operator fares page re-read 9 Oct 2026: €19, 12 journeys, shareable, 6-month validity, TD/night = 2 journeys.

items.name: Explore Flex card
items.address: Same sales points as the Explore card
items.price_range: 4-day from €21; 7-day €27; +€6 add-on for 2 Airport Direct trips; top-up credit can pay the Valletta↔Sliema/Three Cities ferry
items.description: Unlimited bus plus a pick of Gozo fast-ferry return or harbour cruise (or both) — the right card only if you're doing the Gozo day trip by Highspeed ferry.
items.notes: Operator fares page re-read 9 Oct 2026: from €21 (4-day) / €27 (7-day), €6 Airport Direct 2-trip add-on, ferry top-up option.

items.name: White taxi (airport fixed-fare kiosk)
items.address: 24/7 pre-paid kiosk in the airport arrivals hall
items.price_range: €25–28 fixed to Qawra/Buġibba + small admin fee (~€28 all-in per 2026 guides); metered away from the airport
items.description: Pay at the kiosk, get a receipt, hand it to the waiting driver — no haggling, no meter surprises. The convenience play for arrival with luggage and for the departure run.
items.notes: Fixed fares from mappytravel's airport taxi table (Qawra €28, Buġibba €28, Ta' Qali €21) corroborated by discover-world.eu (Qawra €25, Buġibba €25) and airporttocitycenter.com (27 Sep 2026: 'EUR 28 Buġibba and Qawra'). The airport's own fixed-fare table page now routes via maltataxi.mt — confirm the exact fare at the kiosk before paying.

items.name: Uber / Bolt / eCabs / Ryde
items.area: Island-wide (densest in the Sliema/St Julian's belt)
items.address: App-booked; Uber has a dedicated pickup zone at MLA (UberX only)
items.hours: 24/7 (Uber: no advance booking; Bolt/eCabs/Ryde: advance booking supported)
items.price_range: Airport→Qawra ≈ €15–30 (estimate); Qawra→Ta' Qali venue ≈ €10–18 (estimate); per-car price, splits well 2–4 ways
items.description: The bridge between bus and taxi: reserve a Bolt/eCabs for a fixed event-day start, use Uber for on-demand in town. Four apps operate (Uber, Bolt, eCabs, Ryde).
items.notes: Operator set (Uber/Bolt/eCabs/Ryde) per maltaadvice.com ride-hailing comparison and rozie.app (Jun 2026); Uber-at-MLA (UberX, pickup zone, no advance booking) per uber.com's MLA page and flipflopsincluded (Jan 2026). Fare bands are planning estimates from appsavvytraveller (Sep 2026: Bolt/Uber €15–22 airport transfers) and rome2rio towncar ranges — not quotes; check the app on the day.

items.name: Valletta Ferry Services (harbour ferry)
items.address: Sliema (near Ferries), Valletta (Barrakka landing), Cospicua/Senglea/Birgu (Three Cities)
items.hours: Every 30 min; summer timetable to 31 Oct (Sliema departures 06:45–01:00; Sundays from 08:45)
items.price_range: €3.00 single / €5.00 return by day; €3.50 / €5.20 after 19:30; child €1 / €1.50
items.description: The scenic way between Sliema and Valletta and to the Three Cities — ~10 min crossing, and the cheapest harbour cruise on the island. From Qawra, reach Sliema by bus 212/222 or rideshare first.
items.notes: Official operator fares/timetable verified 24 Sep 2026 (previous session; page unchanged at that read). Service is weather-dependent — suspended in harbour swell (happened 23–24 Sep 2026, resumed same evening); check the operator's homepage banner before setting out.

items.name: Gozo ferries (Gozo Channel + Gozo Highspeed)
items.address: Ċirkewwa terminal (Malta north tip); Mġarr (Gozo); Valletta (Highspeed); Buġibba (Highspeed, 30 min)
items.hours: Gozo Channel ~every 45 min incl. nights (~25 min crossing); Highspeed Valletta↔Mġarr 45 min
items.price_range: Gozo Channel foot passenger €4.65 return (paid on the Gozo side); Highspeed €7.50 one way from Valletta (Buġibba €6.50; Sliema €8.50/€6.50 with tallinja card)
items.description: The only realistic way to Gozo without a car. From your base, the Buġibba Highspeed jetty (30 min) avoids the 1-hour bus to Ċirkewwa.
items.notes: Official fares verified 24 Sep 2026. FLAG: Highspeed runs a RESTRICTED schedule on 14 & 17 Oct (Rolex Middle Sea Race) and Mġarr terminal works run to 31 Oct; online sales close 20 min before sailing. Re-check the operator banner before any Gozo day.

items.name: Night buses (N1 / N11)
items.address: N1: Buġibba–Qawra–St Paul's Bay; N11: San Ġiljan–…–Salina–Buġibba–Qawra–San Pawl il-Baħar–Xemxija–Mellieħa–Ċirkewwa
items.hours: Night service, primarily Fri/Sat nights (routes extended/added 5 Apr 2026)
items.price_range: €3.00 night fare (2 journeys on the 12-journey card; covered by Explore 7-day)
items.description: The late-night safety net after evening matches or nights out — check whether they run on the nights you need (night routes concentrate on Fri/Sat).
items.notes: N1/N11 lines per hubpymalta bus guide (Jan 2026) and Wikipedia's Buses in Malta (N11 route list, page current Sep 2026); night-route expansion (four new routes + two extensions) per rozie.app (Jun 2026). Night routes run mainly Fri/Sat — a Sunday–Thursday late return after a match may need a taxi/rideshare; N-routes exist in the operator's live route list (N11, N13, N3, N40, N48, N50, N52, N62, N71, N82, N91, N120, N209, N212, N301 seen 9 Oct 2026).

items.name: TQ special event shuttles (Ta' Qali ↔ Qawra/Buġibba)
items.address: TQ1 'North Route': Ta' Qali → Rabat → Mosta → Naxxar → St Paul's Bay → Buġibba → Qawra (example: Earth Garden festival, late-night departures)
items.hours: Special services only — not a regular timetable
items.description: Malta Public Transport runs dedicated Ta' Qali ↔ Qawra/Buġibba shuttles (TQ1–TQ4) for major Ta' Qali events, typically with late-night departures. Watch for a TWC special service — none announced as of 9 Oct 2026.
items.notes: TQ1–TQ4 exist as special-service route numbers (Earth Garden 2023 example: departures 23:15/00:15/01:15/02:15; TQ1 north route serves Buġibba & Qawra) and appear in the operator's live route list (TQ1–TQ4, 9 Oct 2026). No TWC-specific shuttle is announced as of 9 Oct 2026 — do not plan around one; re-check the operator's news page and the TWC format page in the week before travel.

items.name: Buġibba bus station (hub near the hotel)
items.address: Buġibba Terminal, Pioneer Road area, St Paul's Bay
items.price_range: Free to wait; tallinja card sales office on site (Explore 7-day €25 etc.)
items.description: The best boarding point near the hotel: routes 186 (Ta' Qali/Rabat), 212 (Sliema/St Julian's), 221 (Mellieħa/Ċirkewwa), 222 (Sliema/Ċirkewwa), 223 (Golden Bay), 31/45/48 (Valletta/Mosta), X3 (airport) and TD5 (airport, limited hours) serve it. Qawra, Buġibba and St Paul's Bay are one continuous resort strip.
items.notes: Route list from a Bugibba-resident forum answer (2022) corroborated against 2026 sources (route numbers 186/212/221/222/223/31/45/48 all current; X3/TD5 airport services per 2025–2026 guides). The operator's fares page (re-read 9 Oct 2026) confirms a card sales office at the Buġibba Terminal. Use the tallinja app for live departures.

items.name: Car rental
items.address: Deskks at MLA airport and in St Julian's/Sliema
items.description: Full freedom, but driving is on the LEFT, parking in Valletta/Sliema is paid and tight, and the island is small — buses + rideshare cover this itinerary without a car.
items.notes: Daily-rate band is a third-party 2026 guide figure (sliemavillamalta), not a quote. Malta recognises US licences for short stays — confirm with the rental agency's own terms. Not recommended for this trip (see Getting Around § 6).
